# Phase Three — Improvement Checklist

1. Reduce pill geometry in primary menus.
2. Give selected menu items a luminous rectangular edge rather than a swollen bubble.
3. Make glass depth visible through border light, not excessive blur.
4. Keep animation compositor-friendly.
5. Add reduced-motion support.
6. Prevent nested backdrop-filter stacks.
7. Compact provider banner actions.
8. Compact reference explanation in active reference mode.
9. Improve reference role labels.
10. Surface image replacement as a first-class action.
11. Preserve asset identity when replacing image bytes if the domain contract permits.
12. Revoke obsolete object URLs.
13. Ensure image updates survive reload.
14. Ensure image replacement updates all assigned-reference previews immediately.
15. Verify public URL references and local data URLs use correct H3 `image_url` form.
16. Validate supported image types.
17. Validate image size limits.
18. Validate image dimensions and aspect ratio where metadata is available.
19. Enforce 9 reference-image maximum.
20. Enforce one first frame and one last frame.
21. Prevent frame/reference role mixing.
22. Enforce video count and duration rules.
23. Enforce audio count and duration rules.
24. Prevent audio-only reference payloads.
25. Enforce concrete ratio for text-only H3 requests.
26. Force adaptive ratio for first/last-frame image-to-video payloads.
27. Keep reference ratio optional/concrete as supported.
28. Verify exact V2 create endpoint.
29. Verify exact V2 query endpoint.
30. Verify `task_id` handling.
31. Verify all task statuses including cancelled.
32. Verify successful URL extraction from `task.content.url`.
33. Preserve upstream error HTTP status where safe.
34. Test missing-key status and create behavior.
35. Test malformed JSON/body behavior.
36. Test network/upstream timeout behavior.
37. Test browser client methods against local proxy routes.
38. Keep every touched file <=120 lines.
39. Keep tab indentation and expanded functions.
40. Run unit + API contract + local Chrome + production Chrome before release.
